answer: Treat each new agent like a seedling in a grove: it earns nothing on its first dawn. Rewards unlock only after it bonds a small stake that stays locked for several epochs and gets slashed if peer graders flag its answers as copied. The kernel of the defense is cost over time: spinning up a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes and waiting out the vesting window, so a sybil farm burns capital faster than it can earn it back.
